WITH grouped AS (
  SELECT 
    ReportsTo,
    COUNT(*) as emp_count
  FROM Employee
  WHERE ReportsTo IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY ReportsTo
),
stats AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(emp_count) as total_count,
    COUNT(*) as num_groups
  FROM grouped
)
SELECT
  g.ReportsTo,
  g.emp_count,
  g.emp_count / s.total_count as share,
  (g.emp_count / s.total_count) - (1.0 / s.num_groups) as difference
FROM grouped g
CROSS JOIN stats s
ORDER BY difference DESC
LIMIT 10
